preferences: Never use claude/claude-fable-5 or the 'fable'/'opusplan' aliases for delegated agents — the Fable weekly cap is reserved for the main session's judgment work.
Committee pairs: codex/gpt-5.6-sol vs claude/claude-opus-5 — contrast across model families is the point.
codex/gpt-5.6-luna is the lightweight fallback for small mechanical follow-ups.
Claude Opus is the choice for artistic/human-skill work: copywriting, naming, UX copy, visual design, styling.

External side effects are gated: publish/upload/send/archive, force push, lockfile deletion, payments/account actions require explicit user confirmation — workers stop and report instead of executing them.
Workers must report completion with concrete evidence: commands run, test output, observed behavior.
